description: Verify the OTP sent to the user's email and start a direct conversation with a tradesperson. Creates a homeowner account automatically if the email is new.

email.description: The homeowner's email address (same as used in request_chat_otp)

message.description: The initial message to send to the tradesperson

otp.description: The 6-digit OTP code the user received by email

tradesperson_id.description: UUID of the tradesperson to contact

name: start_conversation
